messages:
erin: Heads-up — ran a quick smoke + bench for voyager-9b on a 1xA100(80G) instance. Posting raw numbers and a short summary here.
josh: Nice, thanks. Did you use the default quant profile?
erin: Used q4_0 as a baseline, no KV cache priming. Prompt distribution = 32/64/128 tokens. Batch sizes: 1, 4, 8.
bench-bot: JOB 84321 complete — artifacts: https://internal.ci/bench/84321 (csv + flamegraphs)
maria: Can you paste p50/p95/p99 across the batch sizes here? Quick glance at the graphs is fine.
erin: Paste below (generation-only, per-token times):
```
batch=1: p50=18ms p95=45ms p99=78ms
batch=4: p50=12ms p95=36ms p99=90ms
batch=8: p50=11ms p95=40ms p99=120ms
```
erin: Observations: 1) steady throughput at batch 4, p99 spikes at batch 8 likely due to memory pressure and kernel fallback on long sequences; 2) q4_0 gives ~1.6x speed vs q5_0 we tried earlier on the model card for similar configs; 3) output quality check: ran 50 eval prompts, BLEU/ROUGE-ish heuristics look on-par.
kevin: Did you capture allocator logs or any OOM warnings?
erin: No OOM, but allocator logged some device fragmentation warnings around 1:12:35 in the run (see flamegraph and 'alloc.log' in artifacts).
josh: Any early regressions versus our reference profile (sylph14b baseline)?
erm: sorry typo
maria: @josh FYI sylph14b is not the right comparison — compare to our 9B family baseline (orion9b). How does voyager-9b compare to orion9b same config?
erin: Right — compared to orion9b same q4_0 on 1xA100: voyager p50 ~+6% slower, p95 ~+8%, but token-cost is ~2% lower due to slightly smaller activation footprint and caching improvements.
josh: Sounds reasonable. Can you add a short entry to the onboarding doc with the artifact link and these numbers? Then we can promote to canary tomorrow.
erin: Will do. Drafted blurb below — please edit: 
"Voyager-9b (q4_0) — smoke pass complete on 1xA100. p50=18ms, p95=45ms, p99=78ms at batch=1. Recommended initial canary: 10% traffic on dedicated pool with batch_target=4 and kv_cache_enabled=true. Watch p99 for batch>=8; set fallback to orion9b if memory fragmentation occurs"
kevin: LGTM but drop the exact p99 numbers in the blurb and link to artifact instead to avoid stale values.
erin: Updated: "Voyager-9b (q4_0) — smoke pass complete on 1xA100. See bench artifacts for full latency distributions. Recommended initial canary: 10% traffic on dedicated pool with batch_target=4 and kv_cache_enabled=true. Configure fallback to orion9b for memory fallback conditions"
maria: Quick ask for reviewers: @josh @kevin can you give thumbs by EOD? We want to kick off canary tomorrow morning.
josh: +1
kevin: +1 :thumbsup:
erin: Thanks — I'll push the onboarding doc and add the bench artifact link, then ping infra to schedule a canary window.
bench-bot: Canary schedule request created: CANARY-5592 (waiting approval from infra on window).
